description:
Synthetic test vectors for the v2 port (no real data). Two vectors, default CFG2, stored mount -177.0 deg:
 C1 turn: 15 m/s, heading 30 deg, 6 deg/s right turn 20-30 s, +10 m cross step on fix times 40-50 s (60 s).
 C2 fault + cut-off + stop + handling (200 s): 15 m/s north-east straight, +10 m cross step on fix times 30-60 s
    (opening at onset with no earlier alarm, closing when it ends), AUTO cut-off for receipts 80-120 s
    (status keeps coming), decel to a stop 140-150 s, standing 150-165 s, handling burst (gyro 60 deg/s) at 170-171 s,
    restart 165-175 s back to 10 m/s.
Phone up = +y. AUTO received 0.45 s after its fix time, status at k+0.2 s, diag age 0.45 every 10 s.
Expected outputs: at every AUTO answer and every 1 s serve during the cut-off: served e/n (full precision), state,
acc68, the full state x, b-mode; plus the event list. A port reproduces served e/n within 1e-6 m.
